messages:
Maria Chen: Heads up — noticed ~5% of inbound leads get stuck in 'Enrichment' for >1h and never hit Salesforce owner. Repro steps below. @Omar can you take a look?

Omar Patel: I saw a spike in hs-sync retry errors around midnight. Which HubSpot workflow ID is that?

Maria Chen: Workflow id `assign-owner-rr-v3` (HubSpot). Condition chain uses `enrichment.completed` and `lead.source != 'partner'`. Sample log: `2026-03-20T02:14:22Z hs-sync ERROR: no eligible owner after 3 passes`

hubspot-sync-bot: Sync job 2026-03-20T02:14:22Z failed for lead 00Q1 - reason: owner_round_robin returned empty set

Jen Lawson: Might be a race — HubSpot marks enrichment.complete via external callback but the RR assign step sometimes runs earlier because webhooks are unordered. We had a similar Q1 incident.

Alex Rivera: :thinking_face: Could we add a TTL-based fallback? e.g., if after 10m no owner, set `default_owner` in HS and queue for manual claim. Low ops overhead.

Omar Patel: Two-step mitigation I propose: (1) Add a `default_owner` property on the workflow as a fallback, (2) Add a tiny 30s pause before the RR step to allow enrichment callback ordering to stabilize. Low-risk and fast.

Maria Chen: Delay feels brittle across regions/latency. Alternative: surface a boolean `claimable` flag. RR only picks claimable leads; if not claimed in 15m, fallback to `marketing-inbound@redwood.com`. That avoids timing hacks.

Jen Lawson: Also need SF connector change — right now when owner is empty we sometimes create a blank owner row in SF which blocks downstream reassignment. I'll update the sync to skip owner write when empty.

Omar Patel: I'll open the HubSpot change: add `claimable` property + update workflow. Also will add a Datadog metric `lead.handoff.stuck` and alert at 20/min so we catch regressions quickly.

Maria Chen: Can we get a rollback plan? If this increases churn or misassigns leads, we should be able to revert to current behavior by hotfix.

Omar Patel: :thumbsup: rollout plan: canary 10% of inbound for 24h, watch `hs-sync.errors` and `lead.handoff.latency`. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/hs-workflows/pulls/42 (will add runbook).

hubspot-sync-bot: Workflow patch deployed to staging 2026-03-20T09:00:00Z

Jen Lawson: I'll run a backfill for the currently stuck leads: mark them with `default_owner=marketing-inbound@redwood.com` and add an internal note "manual claim required" so AE queue is aware.

Maria Chen: Great — I'll update the inbound handoff SLA doc: new targets: 15m auto-assignment, 2h manual follow-up. I'll loop in Sales Ops to update playbook and messaging.

Omar Patel: I'll post the postmortem template if anything spikes during canary and add a rollback playbook to the PR.

Maria Chen: Thanks all — please ping in this thread when the staging metric looks green and when you merge.
